//: The run's memory budget (docs/design/performance.md, "Bytes per person"), read by orchestrator/test/memory-budget.test.ts (slow tier): a town of `town` run `days` days on the release kernel, all code, with `threads` engine threads, must peak at no more resident memory than overhead_bytes + bytes_per_person for each person it starts with. The target is target_bytes_per_person (Naz, 2026-10-25: about 50 KB a person, so 50,000 people in some 2.5 GB and 100,000 in 5 GB, beside the fixed overhead); bytes_per_person is the ceiling held now, lowered as each cut lands, to the target. Lowering it goes with the cut that earns it; raising it is a decision, with its entry in docs/decisions.md. Set 2026-10-25 on the Mini from main's build at 4 threads: 203 people peaked at 221 to 230 MB resident, 1,000 at 651 to 668 MB (two runs each), so about 110 MB fixed and 546 KB a person; the ceiling is the worst of those, 558 KB, and about 6% (run to run). Lowered to 480 KB with the streamed state hash (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 553 to 560 MB at 4 threads, 450 KB a person). Lowered to 410 KB with what's been seen held once (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 496 MB at 4 threads, 386 KB a person). Lowered to 390 KB with records delivered without their bytes for code actors (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 476 to 477 MB at 4 threads, 366 KB a person). Lowered to 380 KB with a building's facts held once (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 474 to 475 MB at 4 threads, 365 KB a person). Raised to 415 KB (2026-10-26, docs/decisions.md): 380 left 4% over the cut's own measure, and main, with others' merges beside, measured 380 to 385 KB; a ceiling is now set about 8% over main's measure when it is lowered. Lowered to 400 KB with ids interned (2026-10-26, docs/decisions.md: on a Linux machine 1,000 people 461 to 463 MB at 4 threads, 352 KB a person, against main's 363 there; the Mini reads main about 6% higher, so about 373 KB, and 8% over that). Lowered to 350 KB with records' JSON frozen (2026-10-26, docs/decisions.md: there 1,000 people 409 to 419 MB, 305 KB a person; about 323 on the Mini, and 8% over that). Lowered to 345 KB with each transaction held once (2026-10-26, docs/decisions.md: there 1,000 people 409 to 412 MB, 300 KB a person; about 318 on the Mini, and 8% over that). Lowered to 335 KB with the actors' indexes keyed by interned ids (2026-10-27, docs/decisions.md: there 1,000 people 396 to 403 MB, 290 KB a person; about 307 on the Mini, and 8% over that).
